segments.title: Chương 3: Lá sen hấp gà
segments.content:
Chapter 3: Steamed Chicken in Lotus Leaf

The standoff lasted for about ten seconds before Li Hongmei spoke. “Can that game of yours really make money?”

“Yeah, it can.”

“You’re already in your third year of high school and still playing games, we have to replace your phone!” Li Hongmei took off her apron, glaring at him angrily. “No more playing from now on. You can keep the money yourself, just don’t spend it recklessly.”

“Ah, fine, fine.” Jiang Nian couldn’t care less. He didn’t need a phone to complete the system’s missions anyway.

After saying that, her tone softened again. “This is quite a feast. My son has grown up.”

Hearing this, Jiang Nian couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, his cheeky grin returning.

“When does Old Jiang get off work?”

“Soon. Look at you, so pleased with yourself. Go call Qianqian over for dinner.” Li Hongmei kept a stern face. Her son had been mischievous since he was little; give him an inch and he’d take a mile.

“What about Uncle Xu?” he asked.

Li Hongmei took a watermelon out of the fridge. “He’s away for a business training trip. Left this morning.”

Knock, knock, knock.

The sound of knocking rang out. Xu Qianqian pulled the security door halfway open, revealing a flushed face.

“What do you want?”

“Calling you for dinner. Hey, why is your face so red?” Jiang Nian spotted the anomaly and shamelessly tried to squeeze his way in. “What were you doing at home this afternoon?”

“Get lost!” Xu Qianqian held the door shut with all her might.

Jiang Nian’s hand slapped onto her arm. He immediately felt Xu Qianqian’s whole body stiffen, and then she wailed at the top of her lungs toward the Jiang family’s apartment across the hall.

“Auntie, Jiang Nian is touching me!”

“Huh? No, you...?”

Li Hongmei’s scolding voice came from the kitchen, “Jiang Nian, are you asking for a beating! Don’t bully Qianqian!”

“I didn’t, don’t talk nonsense.” He was suddenly startled and, in a panic, squeezed his way inside. Seeing that Xu Qianqian was about to shout again, he quickly covered her mouth.

“Mmph, mmph, mmph!!”

The two of them were extremely close; he could even see the fine, downy hair on the girl's face. A pair of large, limpid eyes stared at him, filled with panic.

The early summer evening breeze was hot and dry. He could smell the fragrance wafting from Xu Qianqian’s neck and felt a strange sense of awkwardness.

“Don’t shout.”

“Mmph, mmph.”

“I’ll let you go if you stop shouting. Nod if you agree.”

Xu Qianqian whimpered, then nodded.

The moment Jiang Nian let go, she bit him hard. A clear set of teeth marks appeared on his arm. He sucked in a sharp breath from the pain but didn’t dare cry out.

“Xu Qianqian, are you part dog?”

“Hmph, you deserved it.” Xu Qianqian turned her head away.

Perhaps due to the scuffle just now, a faint blush colored her face. Only then did Jiang Nian notice that Xu Qianqian seemed to be dressed differently. He looked her up and down and was slightly stunned.

“A JK skirt? Is it new?”

No wonder she didn’t open the door just now; she was trying on clothes. But it wasn't like she was changing. This JK uniform wasn't revealing, and the skirt wasn't even short. What was there to hide?

Xu Qianqian didn’t think so and felt a little embarrassed.

“What’s it to you!”

“Nothing, it looks good.” Jiang Nian rubbed his arm and walked out. “Come over for dinner later. We’re having your favorite, steamed chicken in lotus leaf.”

Thump. The door closed.

Xu Qianqian stood in her living room, took a deep breath to calm herself, then turned and went back to her room to change.

Seven-thirty.

Jiang Weizheng returned home. He was stunned to see a table full of dishes and set his briefcase aside.

“What’s the occasion?”

“No occasion, your son made all this.” Li Hongmei shot him a look, urging him to wash his hands and eat. At the same time, she called over the two youngsters who were watching TV on the sofa.

“Time to eat, stop watching.”

A moment later, the four of them were at the dinner table. Li Hongmei repeated what Jiang Nian had said earlier. Old Jiang and Xu Qianqian were both flabbergasted, and they all turned to look at Jiang Nian.

“You can make money from that?” Jiang’s dad asked.

“Of course you can, Comrade Old Jiang,” Jiang Nian said without batting an eye.

“For real?” Xu Qianqian glanced at him several times. She had never been short of money growing up; her food and clothes were always a notch above Jiang Nian’s. “You’re still playing games in your third year of high school. Be careful you don’t fail your exams!”

The two of them had been close when they were little, and she would often give Jiang Nian small buns to eat. Later their relationship soured, and later still they both grew up and lost their taste for snacks.

Hearing this, Li Hongmei also lectured him with a stern face, once again mentioning replacing his phone.

Old Jiang picked up a piece of the steamed chicken in lotus leaf with his chopsticks. After one bite, his expression turned complex.

“Xiao Nian, did your grandpa teach you this?”

“Yeah, is it good?”

“Sigh, it’s not as good as your grandpa’s.” Jiang Weizheng sighed and put down his chopsticks. “When I was a kid, your grandpa’s cooking was truly one of a kind.”

After saying that, Jiang Weizheng paused, looking as if he wanted to say more. “Forget it, that’s all in the past. Let’s eat, let’s eat.”

Jiang Nian didn't really care; he didn’t have much of an appetite for his own cooking. He just watched as Xu Qianqian seemed to really enjoy it, uncharacteristically eating two bowls of rice.

Ding! The settlement panel appeared.

[Mission: Cook a lavish dinner for your parents. Reward: 800 RMB (Completed).]

Almost simultaneously, his phone vibrated with a buzz.

Even though Jiang Nian knew it was the bank transfer notification, he couldn’t help but take out his phone to look. He had spent nearly four hundred on groceries, and now with the eight hundred reward credited to his account.

His current balance was 1350.64 RMB.

“By the way, Hongmei, did you pay the utility bills?” Old Jiang suddenly looked up and asked.

“No, what’s wrong?”

“Our utilities seem to be—” He stopped mid-sentence, as if he had remembered something, and turned to look at Jiang Nian. “Did you pay the utility bills?”

“Yeah, what about it?”

Old Jiang was stunned for several seconds. “Nothing. Keep your money for yourself. You’ll have things you need to spend it on when you’re older.”

As he said this, his gaze drifted vaguely toward Xu Qianqian. He couldn’t help but sigh inwardly. His own son was as dense as an ox.

The two families were clearly well-matched and knew each other inside and out. It was a pity the two kids didn’t get along. You can’t force a melon to be sweet, and who knew which lucky punk would end up with the Xu family’s little cabbage.

After dinner, Xu Qianqian and Li Hongmei went to do the dishes while Jiang Nian cleared the table. Twenty minutes later, a bowl of chilled watermelon was brought to the table.

After eating the watermelon and chatting for a while, Xu Qianqian went home.

With the door closed, the family of three also prepared to rest.

Old Jiang sighed. “Xiao Nian, which class is Qianqian in again?”

“The class next to ours, haha!”

The moment Jiang Nian laughed, Old Jiang’s temper flared. “What the hell are you laughing at? If you were half as sensible as Qianqian, we’d have to thank our ancestors.”

Jiang Nian wasn’t laughing at Xu Qianqian, but because a new mission had just refreshed.

[At thirty-eight, your body is already overdrawn. A healthy body is the capital for revolution. Reshaping your physique and enhancing your personal charm are the foundations of your comeback.]

[Side Mission: Complete a 2 km long-distance run in one go (no rests). Reward: 300 RMB.

Complete a 3 km long-distance run in one go (no rests). Reward: 700 RMB.

Complete a 5 km long-distance run in one go (no rests). Reward: 1000 RMB.]

(End of this chapter)
